extra.reason: Done in kotile task/initial-implementation: NpotTileSheetTest added (commit f7ef012) alongside the POT-padding fix in TileSheet; renderHarness/spriteHarness added (4ed9ca4).
Decided: option (a) — GameWorld composes ecs.World; Zone becomes terrain-only; occupants become ECS entities tagged with ZoneMember. See docs/adr/0007-game-world-composes-ecs-world.md.

GameWorld composes ecs.World (ADR-0007); Zone is terrain-only (isWalkable terrain-only; creature ownership removed); occupants are ECS entities (Position+ZoneMember+Renderable+Health+Named, Player marker); added GameWorld.entityAt/isWalkable. Deleted Creature + old world.World. Interim movement/AI/lantern glue lives in MyGame, to be replaced by LightingSystem(s5)/MovementSystem+CombatSystem(s6)/BehaviorSystem(s7). 190 tests green.
Done as part of s3's vertical slice: KotileZoneRenderer now reads ECS entities (Position+Renderable+ZoneMember, Player marker -> always drawn) instead of Zone.creatures.

LightingSystem recomputes each zone's lightMap from LightEmitter entities per tick (replaces Zone.recalculateLightMap). Added LightEmitter(color,radius,calculatorId) + LightCalculators registry. Zone keeps lightMap as system-written state, no longer owns lights. Player lantern is now a LightEmitter (tracks movement automatically; interim lantern glue removed). Deleted LightSource. ZoneLightingTest -> LightingSystemTest. 190 tests green.

FIXED — build + Dokka green on mainline (commit da6213c). Root causes: (1) action rot — Java 11 (Gradle 9 needs 17+), archived wrapper-validation-action@v1, Node-20 action versions, 'coretto' typo, dokka V1 task name under V2 mode, stale bucket4k cname; (2) krogue's includeBuild('../kotile') had no kotile on CI; (3) accumulated ktlint violations the broken CI never caught. Fixes: modernized all 4 workflows (setup-java 21, @v4 actions, gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@v4, dokka :dokkaGenerateHtml + build/dokka/html + permissions:contents:write + peaceiris@v4); added git-clone of kotile sibling; made kotile repo PUBLIC (user-approved) so the clone works; ran ktlintFormat. build+Dokka verified GREEN. pr.yml (PR-only) and release.yml (manual dispatch) fixed by the same patterns, verified by inspection not a live run. Note: GitHub warns @v4 actions still run on Node20 (informational, non-failing; GitHub auto-migrates to Node24).

Movement & combat are systems: MoveIntent + AttackIntent components; MovementSystem resolves MoveIntents (walk/ bump-attack->AttackIntent / wall no-op); CombatSystem applies damage + despawns dead non-player. MyGame registers movement->combat->lighting, routes player input + interim AI through MoveIntent, drops interim moveEntity/attack/dead-removal. Only name-based AI remains interim (->s7 BehaviorSystem). 196 tests (+6), build+ktlint green locally.

Behavior(strategyId) component + BehaviorStrategy/BehaviorStrategies (wander, hunt-player) + BehaviorSystem (injectable resolver) replace the interim name-based AI; creatures spawn with Behavior. Deleted all legacy world entity classes (MovableEntity, Entity, ZonalPosition, Pointer, HighlightedCoordinate); Tile made self-contained (was extending Entity). world/ is now GameWorld+Zone+Tile. 200 tests (+4), build+ktlint green.

Phase 4b complete: all 7 steps done. Existing entities migrated onto the ECS; GameWorld composes ecs.World (ADR-0007); behavior/movement/combat/lighting are systems; legacy world entity classes deleted. 200 tests green.

Multi-zone transitions implemented (ADR-0008). Part 1: active-only simulation seam — GameWorld.simulatedZones() (default {currentZoneId}); BehaviorSystem + LightingSystem scoped via activeZones provider; dormant zones freeze; fixed HuntPlayer cross-zone bug. Part 2: Portal component + PortalSystem (player steps onto stairs -> switch zone + move player + currentZoneId follows); MovementSystem treats portals as non-blocking; renderer rebuilds on zone change. MyGame demo: two zones linked by >/< stairs. 204 tests (+4). Follow-ups: per-zone fog (filed), current+adjacent sim (krogue-s67).

Added com.sletmoe.krogue.random: SerializableRandom (xoshiro256** as a kotlin.random.Random with serializable 4-long state), SplitMix64 (seeding + stream-seed derivation), GameRandom (master seed -> named isolated streams; snapshot/restore). Per ADR-0009: shareable deterministic seeds + exact-resume RNG. MyGame draws worldgen/placement from a 'worldgen' stream and AI/combat from a 'gameplay' stream (same master seed => same world). +9 tests (213). Independently useful before save/load.

Added com.sletmoe.krogue.registry: Registry<T> + GameModule (builder facade; engineDefaults() + consumer additions) bundling per-concern strategy/calculator registries (ADR-0009 hybrid iii). Built-in ids moved onto classes (WanderStrategy.ID, HuntPlayerStrategy.ID, Diminishing/GlobalLightValueCalculator.ID). Deleted LightCalculators + BehaviorStrategies stub objects; BehaviorSystem/LightingSystem resolve via injected narrow seams; MyGame builds GameModule.engineDefaults(). ComponentRegistry/SerializersModule deferred to s3 (CBOR). +3 tests.

CBOR save/load codec (ADR-0009). Added kotlinx-serialization plugin + cbor dep. @Serializable + stable @SerialName discriminators on savable components (Position/ZoneMember/Named/Health/Renderable/Player/LightEmitter/Behavior/Portal) + NormalizedRgb/RenderLayer; Tile @Serializable via GdxColorSerializer (RGBA8888). ComponentRegistry (polymorphic SerializersModule) added to GameModule (component<T>()). RandomState/GameRandomState @Serializable. World.restore/nextEntityId (internal). SaveCodec.save/load over entities+terrain(grids)+RNG+turn+currentZoneId; SaveEnvelope{formatVersion,payload} version-first seam; fail-fast on mismatch; transient components excluded; EntityId+nextId preserved. +2 round-trip tests (218 total). Game owns triggers (not wired into demo).

Phase 4f complete: all 3 steps done (RNG streams, registry/GameModule, CBOR codec) per ADR-0009. Shareable deterministic seeds + exact save/resume delivered; engine-extension story via GameModule. 218 tests green.

Event bus implemented (ADR-0010): generic ecs.EventBus with publish-enqueues/dispatch-delivers model owned by World, drained per-tick; game events EntityDamaged/EntityDied/ZoneChanged emitted by CombatSystem/PortalSystem; 8 EventBus tests + system-test assertions (230 tests total); docs updated.

AI strategy abstraction formalized (machinery landed with 4f registry, ADR-0009): BehaviorStrategy SPI extracted to its own file with consumer contract; built-ins wander/hunt-player; 'Extending the engine' docs (write -> register on GameModule -> tag Behavior(id) -> BehaviorSystem resolves); end-to-end test driving a custom-registered strategy through the real registry. Phase 4 complete.

Per-zone fog memory persists across zone transitions: hoisted the 'previously seen' Grid out of KotileZoneRenderer into a host-owned ZoneFog (one grid per zone, reused on return) and inject it into the renderer, so the rebuild on a zone change no longer wipes exploration. 3 ZoneFog tests (234 total). Save/load persistence of fog filed as krogue-k77.
